name: agento
description: Spend less of your Claude Code budget without losing quality: right-sized models at task start, cheap subagents, plan-to-code handoff, loop guard.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: balanced: route cheap subagents and warn about loops. eco: same, plus more eager suggestions. quality: observe only, never change a model. off: do nothing.

autopilot.title: Autopilot
autopilot.description: clean-points (default): at a clean point (first prompt, after /clear or a compaction, cold cache) agento sets a cheaper model and effort for the task itself when it is confident, says so, and offers an undo. Never raises anything, never changes the model mid-task. off: suggestions only.

orchestrate.title: Orchestrator mode
orchestrate.description: on (default): adds one fixed section to the system prompt that tells the main model when to delegate to the agento-scout, agento-builder and agento-checker subagents. Applies from the next session.

prune.title: Prune stale outputs
prune.description: on (default): right before a compaction (/compact or the automatic one), tool outputs superseded by a later identical call (the same file read again, the same command run again) are replaced by a one-line stub, so the summarizer reads less. The latest messages are never touched. off: never.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: on: show banners above the prompt (lighter model for a light task, new context for a new topic, plan handoff, stuck agent). off: no suggestion banners (the stuck-agent warning stays).

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Language of banners and of the orchestrator section. auto follows LANG.

brain.title: Local classifier (brain)
brain.description: auto: at a task's start, ask the local agento-brain daemon which model and effort fit, if its socket answers; any problem and the built-in rules decide. off: always the built-in rules.

brainSocket.title: Brain socket
brainSocket.description: Path of the agento-brain unix socket. Empty: $AGENTO_HOME/brain.sock (AGENTO_HOME defaults to ~/.agento).

brainTimeoutMs.title: Brain timeout (ms)
brainTimeoutMs.description: The longest agento waits for the brain daemon before the built-in rules answer instead.
